messages:
anya: quick design question for Usage page: should org totals stay sticky while scrolling project rows? thinking it helps context. sketch: https://redwood.app/s/sticky-toolbar :thought_balloon:

matt: yes sticky header please. without it you lose context when scanning long lists. also: show a clear scope toggle (Account / Project).

frank: perf + a11y notes: virtualize rows + lazy-load invoice details. sparklines need alt text and 4.5:1 contrast. avoid hover-only controls.

olivia: copy nits: use 'Token usage' instead of 'Token count', and label download as 'Download PDF' with invoice number in aria-label. date format = YYYY-MM-DD.

anya: thought: compact rows with a chevron that opens a right flyout showing recent invoices + token breakdown. inline most-recent invoice only for power users.

matt: prefer flyout for keyboard flow. ensure Enter/Space toggles and Escape closes; aria-expanded + aria-controls on the chevron.

frank: API sketch: return lightweight rows with summary + details_url; details endpoint returns invoices and token breakdown. no base64 blobs in main response.

billing-bot: New invoice rwd-20260630-77 processed ($789.00) -> https://billing.redwood/invoices/rwd-20260630-77 :receipt:

olivia: thanks. one more: tooltip text for scope toggle = 'Show account totals' — short and friendly.

anya: I'll update Figma with sticky header + compact rows + flyout variant and include an accessibility checklist. sharing tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
